alice: Quick monthly checkpoint — I ran the recurrence scan for the last 90 days and there are 7 incidents that share a clear signature: `kv-cache stale entries` (timeouts + NPEs on fetch).
ben: Yep, saw that pattern too. Most spikes line up with autoscaler churn and long tail cold starts.
sasha: I can take ownership of a runbook and a postmortem summary. Will need logs + repro steps.
alice: Assigned: Sasha -> runbook + reproducibility (INF-4721).
mike: I can look into autoscaler tuning and safe-warming heuristics. Putting INF-4722 on my plate.
carla: I will coordinate with infra on instance boot scripts and AMI bake continuity. Adding RUN-88 for bake verification.
ben: Proposed timeline? This is hitting throughput-sensitive customers; would like fixes staged in 3 weeks.
sasha: Timeline: draft runbook by 2026-04-10, repro + smoke test by 2026-04-17.
mike: I can prototype autoscaler change + canary within 2 weeks, target 2026-04-06 for canary.
carla: Infra verification and AMI roll by 2026-04-12.
alice: OK owner summary: Sasha (runbook & root-cause), Mike (autoscale + warm pool), Carla (AMI/bake infra). Ben will own customer impact comms.
incident-bot: Digest created: "recurrence-scan-2201" -> https://redwood.internal/ops/digests/2201
sasha: Quick note — log query I used: ```sql
SELECT count(*) AS cnt, signature
FROM incidents
WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '90 days'
GROUP BY signature
ORDER BY cnt DESC;
```
ben: Good example. Also saw elevated error rate when token-cache TTL hit 0 during restart sequence. Not sure if separate signature or part of same chain.
alice: Action item table (quick):
- INF-4721: Sasha - runbook + repro - due 2026-04-10
- INF-4722: Mike - autoscale warm-pool + canary - due 2026-04-06
- RUN-88: Carla - AMI bake + verification - due 2026-04-12
- COMM-121: Ben - customer-impact note + FAQ - due 2026-04-08
Make sure to link postmortem PRs to these tickets.
sasha: I'll create the PR template with checks: repro steps, perf regression test, histogram of tail latency and kv-cache misses.
mike: fyi I'll add a simple canary gate: if tail latency > 1.2x baseline for 5m, rollback.
carla: I'll coordinate a maintenance window with infra team and add a smoke-run checklist.
alice: Also flagging recurring pattern owner: ops-patterns squad — add to their weekly agenda so we don't re-litigate.
ben: re: metrics — can someone add a dedicated dashboard tile for `kv_cache_miss_rate` & `cold_start_tail_latency`? Sasha?
sasha: Yep, will add both and a short alert: P0 if kv_cache_miss_rate > 5% sustained 10m.
incident-bot: Reminder set: follow-up sync on 2026-04-18 at 10:00 PT.
alice: Perfect. Quick ask: when you create tickets, add `recurrence=kv-cache` tag so the recurrence scan picks them up automatically.
mike: Will do.
carla: Adding runbook link and verification tasks to RUN-88 now.
ben: Thanks all — I'll draft the customer-facing note after Sasha posts the repro summary.
sasha: Drafting now, will link INF-4721 here when ready.
alice: Closing this thread for now — use the ticket threads for granular updates. Re-open here if blockers show up in the canary. :thumbsup:
